title: Lean 4 Metaprogramming Book Reference Readout

canonical_node.axiom: The Lean 4 metaprogramming book is a reference for building Lean tooling, not canon evidence.
definitions: Lean 4 metaprogramming book: a reference book for Lean 4 metaprogramming, tactics, and DSLs.
Canon evidence: material that directly supports Theophysics axioms or derivations.
QUARANTINE: a directory for files not admitted into the canon proof package.
derivation: The document states it is a reference book for Lean 4 metaprogramming.
It explicitly says it is not Theophysics canon evidence.
It recommends using it only for Lean-side tooling.
It was copied under QUARANTINE, indicating it is not part of the canon.
canonical_node.action: Treat this document as a tooling reference only; do not use its examples as canon proof.
boundary: Does not provide Theophysics axioms or derivations.

test: Check that no Lean examples from this document are cited in canon proofs.

plain_summary: This document is a readout of a Lean 4 metaprogramming book, explicitly marked as not canon evidence. It is useful for building Lean tooling but must remain quarantined and not be used in Theophysics proofs.
